skills.desc:

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Stuffed Sugarcoated Bullet
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
A powerful ranged strike, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Hold  down to charge up this attack, during which a small energy field is generated at the muzzle as Energy is consumed, dealing bonus DMG to enemies nearby.

skills.name: Core Passive: Mechanical Case
skills.desc: After hitting an enemy with a Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, Nicole can reload, enhance her Basic Attack and Dash Attack. When her enhanced bullets or Energy Field hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by X% for 3.5s.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Hare of Many Burrows
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Nicole's Core Passive: Mechanical Case applies a debuff to an enemy, all units deal 25% more Ether DMG to the target for 3.5s.

cons.name: Supercharged Bomb
cons.desc: The DMG and the Anomaly Buildup inflicted by Nicole's EX Special Attack increases by 16%. For each additional 0.1s of charging when Nicole activates her EX Special Attack, the duration of the energy field created at the target location increases by 0.15s.

cons.name: Charging Device
cons.desc: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when Core Passive: Mechanical Case's debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

cons.name: A Hare's Cunning
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Field Expansion
cons.desc: When Nicole uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.

cons.name: Industry Star
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Corrupting Energy Field
cons.desc: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all units' CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
